mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_file (original_name, stored_name, stored_path, url, size, content_type, sha256, scene, uploader_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version) VALUES (#{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{storedPath}, #{url}, #{size}, #{contentType}, #{sha256}, #{scene}, #{uploaderId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{version}, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT id, original_name, stored_name, stored_path, url, size, content_type, sha256, scene, uploader_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version FROM sys_file WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_file SET url = #{url}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
